integrity: The invariant ring, singularity normal forms and boundary intersection are proved algebraically and checked by a standalone executable script; finite-field enumeration is only a sanity check.
limitations: The quotient and finite compactification are established for a framed unordered coefficient chart with nonzero coefficient sum, not for a coarse moduli space or stack.
No assertion that the cubic is a canonical compactification of the Prym target.
Journal-version and 2023 thesis full text were not material-inspected beyond accessible descriptions; priority risk persists.
No independent scientific validation has been performed.
title: A cubic del Pezzo compactification of a genus-three Prym-deck coefficient quotient
